periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the image vertical, aligning with the tilted facial axis toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with an elongated vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 3:2.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering toward the medial-inferior quadrant, creating a teardrop effect.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior boundary of the transverse band exhibits a shallow U-shaped curve across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately one-third of the visible torso length along the lateral-dorsal transition.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral spacing between pinnae, approximately double the width of the ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the apex of both ears.
